# Lesson Plan: Adding Fractions with the Same Denominator

**Subject:** Mathematics
**Class:** Grade 4
**Duration:** 35 minutes
**Learning objective:** By the end of the lesson, pupils will be able to add two fractions that have the same denominator, and explain why the denominator stays the same.
**Materials:** Paper fraction strips (pre-marked into 5, 7, 8 and 10 equal parts), coloured pencils, mini whiteboards and markers, pair activity cards (3 problems each), exit ticket slips, workbook.

| Time | Phase | What the teacher does | What pupils do |
|------|-------|-----------------------|----------------|
| 0-4 min | Warm-up | Recall prior knowledge of halves and quarters: ask what fraction you get when one thing is cut into 2 equal parts and you take 1, then 4 equal parts. Ask which is bigger, one half or one quarter, and why. | Answer orally, give reasons. |
| 4-5 min | Objective | Announce the objective written on the board ("Today we will add fractions with the same denominator") and have the class read it aloud. | Read the objective together. |
| 5-10 min | Explain with fraction strips | Give each pupil a paper strip folded/marked into 5 equal parts. Pupils shade 1 part, then 2 more parts, and count the shaded fifths. Explain that the parts keep the same size, so we only count how many parts we have. | Fold and shade strips, say "three fifths". |
| 10-12 min | Address the common mistake | Show the wrong answer 1/5 + 2/5 = 3/10. Ask pupils to use their strip to explain why it is wrong (the denominator tells the size of the parts; we do not add the denominators). | Vote, then explain using the strip. |
| 12-14 min | Worked example on the board | Model 1/5 + 2/5 step by step on the board: (1) check the denominators match, (2) add the numerators, (3) keep the denominator. | Watch and copy the steps. |
| 14-17 min | Guided practice (whole class) | Work through 2/8 + 3/8 and 1/6 + 4/6 together, asking pupils to give each step. Ask one pupil to explain how they knew. | Answer chorally and individually. |
| 17-22 min | Pair activity | In pairs, pupils solve 3 problems from the activity card (2/7 + 3/7, 1/4 + 2/4, 3/10 + 4/10) using their fraction strips, then write the answers. Teacher circulates and supports. | Solve with a partner using strips. |
| 22-24 min | Peer checking | Pairs swap cards with the pair behind them and check each answer with strips; tick or discuss any disagreement. | Check another pair's work. |
| 24-27 min | Whole-class check | Mini whiteboards: everyone writes the answer to 3/9 + 4/9 and shows on "3, 2, 1". Then thumbs up / sideways / down for confidence. | Show boards, show thumbs. |
| 27-29 min | Recap the rule | Ask a pupil to state the rule in one sentence; class repeats it. | State the rule. |
| 29-32 min | Exit ticket | One question each on a slip (2/6 + 3/6). Pupils write name and answer; teacher collects all slips before pupils leave. | Answer individually and hand in. |
| 32-34 min | Homework | Set workbook page 42, questions 1-5. | Note the homework. |
| 34-35 min | Extension (optional, if time permits) | Fast finishers make up their own story problem that adds two fractions with the same denominator. | Write a story problem. |
